review.imagery: Root reviewed all45 original index spreads and all11 extracted scenes. Eight selected entries use the phase-six feature facade, collection pool/gym/corner/interiors, shared Arada family-room concept and Aljada context. The broad repeated earlier-phase frontage images on spreads3/42 and duplicate cover are excluded from the gallery. Native sources remain intact.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all26 staged complete spreads and every one of the40 enlarged visible numeric panels. Twenty-five options cover every original apartment type, all nine floors and both master maps. Range endpoints and H1 minimum manually read from final printed tables. Source types I1/I2/J1/J2 and 3BR F1 retained exactly. Complete sheets, notices and physical-page links preserved.
